scope: Read-only preparation for a new private CODE retained session. Existing staging/resource/registry APIs were inspected against R4/R5. No production, contract, test, fixture, candidate, Git or network mutation was performed.

helpers.name: staging._open_batch_session
helpers.signature: _open_batch_session(batch_id: object, *, create: bool) -> contextmanager
helpers.reuse: Retains checkout, .work and batch descriptors and identities; verifies on entry, normal exit and exception exit. Returns _RetainedBatchSession with checkout_fd/work_fd/batch_fd and work_root/batch_path.
helpers.adaptation: Use as a lineage primitive only after adding CODE-scoped complete-set state; do not let its create path silently create arbitrary CODE family directories.

helpers.name: _RetainedBatchSession.verify
helpers.signature: _RetainedBatchSession.verify(self) -> None
helpers.reuse: Checks retained descriptor identities, reopens named checkout/.work/batch edges and checks .work ancestry.
helpers.adaptation: Call at every CODE checkpoint and on all exits; extend with CODE input/output roots and family descriptors.

helpers.name: _require_fd_inside_work
helpers.signature: _require_fd_inside_work(fd: int, work_fd: int, path: Path) -> None
helpers.reuse: Checks live directory, /proc fd path where available, then ascends directory descriptors to prove containment and detect loops.
helpers.adaptation: Useful for input/output roots below .work, but must be paired with equality/ancestor disjointness and named-edge snapshots for both roots.

helpers.name: _require_work_still_in_checkout
helpers.signature: _require_work_still_in_checkout(work_fd: int, checkout_fd: int, path: Path) -> None
helpers.reuse: Proves the retained .work descriptor remains the named child of the retained checkout and has the expected basename/path.
helpers.adaptation: Keep unchanged as the checkout/.work authority check; CODE must not rely on path-only realpath checks.

helpers.name: _require_staging_fds
helpers.signature: _require_staging_fds(*, parent_fd: int, work_fd: int, checkout_fd: int, path: Path) -> None
helpers.reuse: Combines containment and checkout/.work authority checks before/after staging operations.
helpers.adaptation: Use as a low-level precondition only; it does not inspect CODE complete sets or resource/input descriptors.

helpers.name: staging._open_dir_path / _open_dir_at
helpers.signature: _open_dir_path(path: Path) -> int; _open_dir_at(parent_fd: int, name: str, path: Path) -> int
helpers.reuse: Uses directory/O_NOFOLLOW/CLOEXEC flags and rejects symlink/non-directory descriptors.
helpers.adaptation: Add explicit CODE mode/identity policy after open; _open_dir_at does not enforce 0700, nlink or complete-set membership.

helpers.name: source_catalog_io._Tree
helpers.signature: _Tree(); directory(path, optional=False, create=False); observe_set(path, kind); file(path, optional=False, private=False, maximum=MAX_CACHE); verify(); close()
helpers.reuse: Captures named edges and descriptors, exact regular-file bytes, stat size bounds, single-link requirement, optional private 0600 mode, directory sets and all-exits verification via verify_all.
helpers.adaptation: Strong template for CODE retained state. Use observe_set(..., kind='all') or a new CODE scanner before any classification; do not use its filtered 'schemas'/'python' modes for CODE unknown-entry policy. Add CODE family filename/type/mode checks and output logical-byte accounting.

helpers.name: _Tree._verify_edge / _verify_file / _verify_set / verify
helpers.signature: _verify_edge(edge); _verify_file(edge); _verify_set(path, kind, names); verify()
helpers.reuse: Rechecks named edge and retained fd identity, file bytes/link count, complete scoped name sets and all retained groups even after an earlier failure.
helpers.adaptation: Use the verify_all ordering as the R5 all-exits model; distinguish authorized current-command temp/install edges from foreign entries and preserve the first lineage failure.

helpers.name: markdown_source_io.RetainedFile / retain_files
helpers.signature: RetainedFile(path: Path | str, *, maximum: int, required: bool = True); retain_files(specs)
helpers.reuse: No-follow ancestor capture, optional missing slot, regular single-link and size checks, bounded reads, named-edge/fd/byte verification and final verification on every exit. adopt(identity, data) binds a file created by the installer.
helpers.adaptation: Useful per-file model for CODE request/intent/bundle/observation/body/config/handoff slots. Extend exact mode policy, ctime/dev/ino identity as required, initial-absence lineage state and path-key family accounting.

helpers.name: markdown_source_io.MarkdownSlots
helpers.signature: MarkdownSlots(session, *, create: bool); verify(); install(name, data)
helpers.reuse: Captures full direct names before parsing; rejects unexpected names; retains fixed slots; checks complete set and directory lineage around each install.
helpers.adaptation: Template for a CODE fixed-family object. It is too narrow for seven slots/families and its install delegates to legacy _atomic_install, so only its capture/verify structure is reusable.

helpers.name: secure_io.read_child_regular
helpers.signature: read_child_regular(parent_fd, name, *, path, missing_code, unsafe_code, changed_code=SOURCE_CHANGED, max_bytes=None, limit_code=BLOB_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) -> bytes
helpers.reuse: No-follow stat/open, same-fd identity, bounded read and named-edge recheck.
helpers.adaptation: Must add nlink==1 and CODE mode policy: current helper rejects symlink/special/nonregular but does not reject a hardlinked regular input. Keep raw stat charging before read.

helpers.name: source_catalog_io.Generation / generation
helpers.signature: Generation(tree); generation() -> contextmanager
helpers.reuse: Retains package/source schema and projection resources through _Tree, records resource hashes/profile and enters a captured resource view for the operation.
helpers.adaptation: Reuse the capture pattern only. Generation is catalog-specific, requires an installed filesystem package, has taxonomy/catalog assumptions and only checks its catalog PROFILE_SHA; CODE needs a six-envelope/profile resource set with exact expected names/hashes and no package/CWD fallback.

helpers.name: resources._retained_resource_view
helpers.signature: _retained_resource_view(material, schema_names) -> contextmanager
helpers.reuse: Installs an immutable MappingProxyType of captured bytes in a ContextVar and restores the prior view on exit.
helpers.adaptation: Bind only after independently checking material key schema, exact resource hashes and schema_names. The helper checks only tuple keys/bytes and does not itself validate profile identity or names.

helpers.name: resources._schema_text_without_cwd / schema_resource_names / load_schema_json
helpers.signature: _schema_text_without_cwd(filename); schema_resource_names() -> tuple[str,...]; load_schema_json(filename)
helpers.reuse: When a retained view is active, schema reads come only from captured material and schema names; no package/repository/CWD fallback is consulted.
helpers.adaptation: Use inside the CODE retained view only; never call the default fallback path after the session's resource identity is bound.

helpers.name: contracts._registry / _schema_registry
helpers.signature: _registry() -> tuple[Registry, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]; _schema_registry() -> tuple[...]
helpers.reuse: Builds a fresh referencing Registry from schema resources; under _RESOURCE_VIEW, _registry rebuilds parsed resources rather than reusing mutable schema objects.
helpers.adaptation: Use the fresh registry path with CODE's captured view. The default _default_registry is lru-cached and must not be used as a substitute for a per-command profile/resource binding.

helpers.name: staging._mkstemp_at
helpers.signature: _mkstemp_at(dir_fd: int, path: Path) -> tuple[int, str]
helpers.observed: O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL with O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC when available, mode 0600 and bounded random sibling-name retries.
helpers.gap: It does not retain/verify the named edge before writing and does not itself enforce CODE byte budget or exact all-exits cleanup.

helpers.name: staging._link_at
helpers.signature: _link_at(*, src_name: str, dst_name: str, src_dir_fd: int, dst_dir_fd: int) -> None
helpers.observed: os.link with follow_symlinks=False, falling back to a call without that keyword on TypeError.
helpers.gap: R5 requires an explicit private CODE no-follow primitive; the fallback and absence of retained source-descriptor publication semantics must not be inherited blindly.

helpers.name: staging._unlink_at
helpers.signature: _unlink_at(parent_fd: int, name: str) -> None
helpers.gap: R5 lines 132-138 expressly forbid using this helper for CODE cleanup; cleanup failures and replacement/missing names must surface as refusal evidence.

helpers.name: staging._atomic_install
helpers.signature: _atomic_install(work_fd, parent_fd, filename, data, *, target, checkout_fd, return_identity=False) -> bool | tuple[bool, os.stat_result]
helpers.observed: Writes/fsyncs/fstats a temp, closes its descriptor before link, hard-links temp to the final, adopts an identical existing target on EEXIST, fsyncs directories, then silently unlinks the temp in finally.
helpers.gap: It permits late identical-target adoption, has no zero-progress write guard, does not retain the source descriptor through link/cleanup and may remove destination on a post-link session failure. It is unchanged legacy behavior and is not a valid CODE installer.

helpers.name: staging.stage_bytes
helpers.signature: stage_bytes(*, batch_id: object, relative: tuple[str, ...], data: bytes) -> StageResult
helpers.observed: Legacy public wrapper performs path checks, creates 0755 directories, rewalks descriptors, reuses same bytes and calls _atomic_install.
helpers.gap: R5 keeps public stage_bytes unchanged; the private CODE session must not call it or infer its reuse/mode/cleanup semantics.

required_private_phases: capture complete scoped directory names before unknown/unsafe classification
retain input/resource/family descriptors and initial named-edge absence/presence identity
charge observed regular-file st_size before read and enforce mode/nlink/type policies
preflight C + 2*N before private temp creation
create one O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW 0600 temp, retain fd and verify name/fd identity
write bounded bytes with short-write and zero-progress handling, fsync and revalidate all retained inputs
os.link no-replace from the checked temp name to initially absent final; verify link count two and exact inode/bytes/mode
identity-check and remove only the owned temp with surfaced cleanup errors
verify temp absence, final single-link identity, directory fsync, complete set and all retained lineages on every exit

policy: Capture absence as an initial state; a request alone has no acquisition mode.
Only a validated intent supplies normalized_text or git_objects mode.
Forbidden fixed files/families refuse even when empty; status never repairs them.
Raw objects are absent/empty/valid OID-sorted prefix only after a retained bundle; non-prefix or unknown bodies refuse.
A complete raw observation requires every declared body; missing dependencies are corruption.
Every reusable target must have been present in the command's initial complete snapshot; a late identical file is lineage failure.
Generated directories are 0700 and output files 0600/single-link; input regular files and directories retain exact observed mode/identity policy.
mode_and_complete_set_policy.implementation_warning: Existing _Tree.observe_set(kind='all') plus per-entry _edge capture is the closest complete-set primitive. Existing filtered scans, _require_safe_transaction_inspect_entries and _open_dir_at alone do not prove the CODE seven-slot/family policy.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: No private CODE retained session type binds checkout/.work/batch, input bundle, output root, resources, all family sets, initial absence/presence and authorized current-command installs in one object.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Define the session fields, checkpoint order, error precedence and close behavior before implementation.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: Existing resource view/registry primitives do not validate the complete CODE profile/resource hash set themselves; default registry/resource fallback remains available outside a retained view.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Capture exact resource bytes and hashes first, reject any missing/changed/extra resource, enter _retained_resource_view, and use a fresh _registry for every command.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: Existing family scanners are either catalog-specific or filtered; no generic CODE scanner enforces unknown sibling/type/mode/link-count rules before parsing or writing.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Capture all direct names and stat identities before classification, then apply the R5 mode matrix and recheck the complete set after every authorized install/cleanup.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: _ensure_dir_at creates 0755 and _open_dir_at does not enforce exact output directory mode; _atomic_install/legacy reuse does not prove final single-link/mode policy for all retained files.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Private CODE directory creation/retention must enforce 0700 generated dirs, 0600 output files, single-link outputs and exact observed input policy.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: Legacy temp cleanup swallows OSError and closes the source fd before publication; post-link rollback can remove a destination without the R5 owned-temp/final-identity matrix.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Implement and adversarially review a private installer with retained source fd, no-replace link, explicit cleanup evidence and no unconditional final rollback.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: _open_batch_session proves checkout/.work/batch only; it does not prove input/output disjointness or raw bundle ancestor/descendant restrictions.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Add retained descriptor identity/equality and strict ancestor checks for input bundle root, output namespace and all resource roots before writes.

gaps_before_private_code_freeze.gap: Existing modules have independent StagingError, SecureIOError and ContractError mappings; no CODE error schema distinguishes budget, lineage, cleanup and semantic failures with R5 lineage precedence.
gaps_before_private_code_freeze.required: Freeze one CODE error mapping and preserve failure evidence through all cleanup/verification paths.

next_action: Use this as preparation for the Architect-owned private CODE retained-session design and implementation freeze. Do not modify or call legacy helpers as if they satisfy R5; do not change public stage_bytes behavior.
